review_evidence: README describes the package as Hax’s Lean proof library containing extracted models of Rust core/std/alloc plus verification tactics.

The source includes formal CoreModels for Rust libraries and Hoare/WP infrastructure, with theorems such as Result.ok_spec, Result.fail_spec, Result.deterministic and Triple composition/entailment lemmas.
These definitions and specification lemmas are part of a program-verification semantics/model library, not merely an editor/build tool, and are useful formal-methods prior art.
summary: Reviewed hax-lean; retain its formal models and verification infrastructure for extracted Rust code.

review_evidence: Ran the declaration-keyword grep across all 33 listed files: thirteen matched zero, two matched exactly one, the remaining eighteen matched between 4 and 1578.

Read all thirteen zero-match files in full: each is a short list of `import` lines, most with a module-level `/-! ... -/` doc comment, no declaration, open, notation, or executable command in any of them.

Read CoreModels/MissingAeneas.lean in full: its one grep hit is the word 'theorem' inside a docstring code example illustrating usage; the file's actual content is a `scoped syntax` and `macro_rules` definition for a `%ToLowerCase` elaboration helper inside `namespace Aeneas.Std.ScalarElab`.
Read Tests/Hax/Tactic/ForLoopWithInvariantSpec.lean in full: a genuine `example` with a full tactic-mode proof of a for-loop invariant specification under `namespace Hax.Tests`.

Confirmed the largest file, CoreModels/Core/Funs.lean (696329 bytes), has 1578 declaration-keyword matches, consistent with it being the bulk auto-extracted Lean model of Rust's `core` crate that the prior review already characterized as the source's formal model content.

Spot-checked CoreModels/RustPrimitives/Funs.lean (48508 bytes, 271 declarations) and CoreModels/Core/Types.lean (45898 bytes, 160 declarations), confirming genuine extracted/verification content rather than stubs.
summary: Ran a declaration-keyword grep over all 33 changed/added files. Thirteen matched zero: CoreModels.lean, CoreModels/Alloc.lean, CoreModels/Command.lean, CoreModels/Core.lean, CoreModels/HaxLib.lean, CoreModels/RustPrimitives.lean, CoreModels/Spec.lean, Hax.lean, Hax/MissingLean.lean, Hax/Tactic.lean, Tests.lean, Tests/Hax.lean, Tests/Hax/Tactic.lean -- all read in full: each is a bare list of `import ...` statements, most followed by a `/-! ... -/` module doc comment describing the subsystem (e.g. CoreModels/Alloc.lean: 'extracted items from our Rust model of alloc'), with no open/notation/executable command; pure import aggregators, retained as navigation data under FILTER-007. Two files matched exactly one keyword hit each but on inspection hold genuine formal content, not a stray declaration: CoreModels/MissingAeneas.lean (read in full) defines a `scoped syntax`/`macro_rules` elaboration extension inside `namespace Aeneas.Std.ScalarElab`, whose sole grep hit is the word 'theorem' occurring inside a docstring code example, not an actual declaration; Tests/Hax/Tactic/ForLoopWithInvariantSpec.lean (read in full) is a genuine end-to-end `example` with a tactic proof (`forLoopWithInvariant_spec`) under `namespace Hax.Tests`. Both retained. All remaining files (CoreModels/Alloc/Funs.lean, CoreModels/Alloc/Types.lean, CoreModels/Core/Funs.lean at 696329 bytes/1578 declarations, CoreModels/Core/FunsEpilogue.lean, CoreModels/Core/FunsPrologue.lean, CoreModels/Core/Types.lean, CoreModels/Core/TypesPrologue.lean, CoreModels/HaxLib/Int.lean, CoreModels/HaxLib/Prop.lean, CoreModels/RustPrimitives/Funs.lean, CoreModels/Spec/RustPrimitives/Arithmetic.lean, CoreModels/Spec/RustPrimitives/Slice.lean, Hax/MissingAeneas.lean, Hax/Tactic/ForLoopWithInvariant.lean, Hax/Tactic/ForLoopWithInvariantSpec.lean, Hax/Tactic/HaxMvcgen.lean, Hax/Tactic/HaxMvcgenAt.lean, Tests/Hax/Tactic/HaxMvcgenAt.lean) matched from 4 to 1578 declaration keywords, matching the prior review's characterization of formal models and verification infrastructure for extracted Rust code. No file meets the FILTER-002/FILTER-004 evidence bar for exclusion; retain all 33.
